source_title: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog
claim_zh_cn: 瑰夏（Gesha）基因决定了其高挥发性单萜烯（如芳樟醇）的高表达上限，浅烘焙下呈现高锐白花与单醇果酸。
claim_en: The Gesha genotype sets a high ceiling for volatile monoterpenes such as linalool; at light roast it reads as sharp white florals and clean, single-note fruit acidity.

source_title: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog
claim_zh_cn: 浅烘保留品种的花香与果酸参照物（花香、柑橘酸、单醇甜感），焦糖化产物尚未主导。
claim_en: Light roasting keeps the variety's floral and fruit-acid references (florals, citric acidity, clean sweetness) before caramelisation products take over.

source_title: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog
claim_zh_cn: 中烘时焦糖化与美拉德参照物（红糖、坚果、可可）与残余果酸达到平衡。
claim_en: At medium roast the caramelisation and Maillard references (brown sugar, nut, cocoa) balance the remaining fruit acidity.

source_title: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog
claim_zh_cn: 深烘下花香与果酸参照物被烘烤参照物（烟熏、焦糖苦、灰烬）覆盖。
claim_en: At dark roast the floral and fruit-acid references are covered by roast references (smoke, burnt caramel, ash).
